conceptual_change: Implement a volatility-scaling function that calculates a dynamic position size multiplier as '1 - (ATR_14 - MA20_ATR_14) / (1.5 * STDEV_ATR_14)' capped between 0.1 and 1.0 when ATR_14 exceeds its 20-period moving average by more than 1.5 standard deviations.

rationale: The previous hypothesis was rejected due to being unexecutable.
